newsitem.title: USA: Network Long Distance sees revs doubling.
newsitem.headline: Network Long Distance sees revs doubling.

text.p: Network Long Distance Inc expects to double its annual revenues through its two most recent merger deals, a Network official told investors at a meeting here Thursday, the company said.
Louis Resweber, executive vice president, also told the investors Network has made a strategic decision to focus on large and high-quality acquisition targets, the company said.

In his presentation to investors, Resweber said the company's merger with United Wats Inc and its proposed merger with Eastern Telecom International Corp were expected to contribute more than $40 million in annualized revenues, the company said.

Resweber also said the additional revenues would raise Network's consolidated pro forma annual sales to more than $80 million, expand the company's market territory and more than double its commercial and small-business customer base, the company said.
Resweber noted that the Eastern deal, when completed, would mark Network's 16th mergers and acquisition transaction, the company said.
